name: M3_CRS200MI_LstOrderType
description: Lists requisition and distribution order types and their main control settings; read-only, maintain in CRS200. Leave all inputs blank to list every order type for the current company. Enter an order type to start the list there (must exist, else error). Optional filters: stock transaction type, next manual function. Auto level, auto receipt, inbound delivery creation and over-receipt settings come from the dispatch policy, not warehouse settings. Over-receipt indicators and percentage control allowed excess over dispatched quantity; 0% removes the check. Flags for two-step put-away, multi-warehouse and BOM requisitions, alternate units, line suffix and zero-quantity lines show expected behavior; integrations should respect them. Representative movement affects reorder-point calculation; authorization level and return-document control affect printing and progression.
